title: Inferential Privacy Leakage in Anonymized Conversational AI Logs

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing asymmetric misclassification rates and chain-of-thought rationales during demographic inference from sanitized chat logs, revealing that technical conversational content is stereotypically attributed to males.

Evaluating error distributions and model rationales in country-of-residence prediction, showing that technical proficiency and fluent English are disproportionately inferred as indicators of Western (US/UK) residency over Global South origins.

Examining per-class inference errors and model reasoning traces to demonstrate that older users discussing contemporary skills, modern software, or using brief informal language are systematically misclassified into younger age brackets.
